name: golden-hour-riding
author: Mark Bright
description: Standalone 3D indoor cycling simulator for macOS and Windows with smart trainer (FTMS) support.

scripts.pack:mac: npm run build:voice:mac && vite build && electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:voice:mac && vite build && electron-builder --mac

extendInfo.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Golden Hour Riding uses Bluetooth to connect to smart trainers and cycling power meters.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Golden Hour Riding uses the microphone for offline voice commands.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Golden Hour Riding uses on-device speech recognition for hands-free riding commands.
